label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness) is TP because rememberMeKey is generated using java.util.Random, which is cryptographically weak for session tokens. Alert 2 (java/xss) is FP because the sink (response.getWriter().println) outputs rememberMe.getName() and rememberMe.getValue(), which resolve to server-side constants (Class Name and Random), not user input. User input (param) is stored in a HashMap but never written to the response.

evidence.note: Uses java.util.Random to generate rememberMeKey used in session/cookie, constituting insecure randomness.
XSS sink prints rememberMe.getName() and rememberMe.getValue(). Tracing shows these resolve to server-side constants (Class Name and Random), not user input.
